name: Payroll Run
summary: Monthly payroll for a 40-person company in PKR, run in six steps, with payslips that print line by line
about: A nine-page payroll app for a 40-person packaging company in Lahore. The month's run moves through attendance, overtime, deductions, income tax, approval and pay, and each step lights up on the pipeline as you finish it. Payslips roll out of a printer slot line by line, and employees, loans and advances, the tax summary, the bank file (CSV), reports and settings all work.
how: Open a page from the slate sidebar, or press Ctrl+K to jump to a page, an action or a person
On Run payroll, fix attendance and overtime in the tables, then press Done to light up the next step
Tick the four checks to approve, download the bank file and mark the month as paid
Pick a person on Payslips to print their slip line by line, or print and email them all
Add or edit employees, approve loan requests and give salary advances with checked forms
Change allowances, PF, EOBI and the tax slabs in Settings, and reset the demo data there
